title: Appealing my leaking ban.

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello Aura.

You leaked old Junior Documents to the likes of Zegita and ciaaran. In addition, you exposed the argument that led to your demotion. Before you left slack, you mentioned that it should stay private to Senior Staff only. However, you later went on Throwback, and exposed the argument. By doing this, you broke Policy 2.4 - Confidentiality Agreement. It clearly states the following: "As a staff member of the Avicus Network, all sensitive information before and after retirement/demotion must be secured at all times and no one any document should be shared or granted to anyone who is not of the appropriate staff position to view it." You broke the policy. With an immediate ban as result. You lied in your appeal. 

Regards,
Pelpelajax.
